title: Planner Handoff (rdd-planner stage exit)
description: Schema for .rddf/state/.planner-handoff.json emitted by rdd-planner stage exit. Consumed by rdd-builder Phase 0 (approval gate reads proposals_ready) and rdd-arch advisory (via .planner-feedback.json). Per spec §3.3, §6.1. v1.1 rename: proposals_authored → proposals_ready (per fix-v4-rdd-planner-scope-over-assignment A3+B3); planner never authors, so the field is renamed to reflect the actual semantics (attached improvements ready for builder consumption). Backward compat: coexists with .planner-state.json (Stage 2, current sprint view) and .planner-feedback.json (ADR-0042, persistent review tasks); each has its own FileLock.

proposals_ready.description: Improvements attached for builder consumption; not an authoring product (planner never authors proposal.md). Renamed from proposals_authored in v1.1 per fix-v4-rdd-planner-scope-over-assignment A3.

awaiting_builder.description: List of change names awaiting builder P0 (added by planner_stage_exit.sh, consumed by rdd-builder to know which changes to pick up next).
